{{Quote|You ''faked'' a distress call? Don't you know that's a violation of the Galactic Navigation Accords?|[[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Crucible (novel)">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
The '''Galactic Navigation Accords''' were a set of guidelines that governed space travel. One of its rules was not to fake a distress call.<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />
